description: Reckless lane: existing-weight true 32-bucket Bullet Enyo input-only divergence smoke.

metadata.hypothesis: Expand the current existing 16-bucket Enyo net into true 32 Bullet Enyo input buckets and train only the input accumulator weights. If king-localized bucket divergence is useful, the duplicate bucket halves should move while the dense head stays fixed.
metadata.why_now: Previous native Bullet Enyo runs were legacy 16-bucket exports. The toolchain now supports true 32-bucket init/export parity, so this tests the existing-weight near-term lane without scratch training.
guardrails: existing-weight initialization only; not a native scratch run
trainable=input only; do not drift dense/output tensors in this smoke
reject if net diff is zero or if broad search/failure tails regress
